# The Big Bloom: Gamma Green Tea

- Duchess Flame![Writer: Duchess Flame]()
- Jan 16, 2025
- 2 min read

Updated: May 20, 2025

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_0b19a0184db042888398b5863f83268b~mv2.jpg)

Image Credit:

__Gamma Green Tea__

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_be352182d63a4bf3888191dc49e3b85a~mv2.jpg)

**Buff:**

- Increases flower harvest yield for 30 minutes.
- Adds one (1) extra flower per plant harvested.
- Applies only to flowers, not fruits.

**What counts as a Flower**

- Afterwind Vine (raw flux)
- Ash Blossom
- Ash Rose
- Aster
- Boom Bloom (raw flux)
- Crackletail (raw flux)
- Decay Vine (raw flux)
- Fever Blossom
- Geiger Blossom (raw flux)
- Irradiated Thistle
- Irradiroot (raw flux)
- Megaton Melon Blossom (raw flux)
- Mutated Fern
- Pot O' Carnal Weeper
- Pot O' Crystalcup
- Pot O' Radlily
- Rad Rose (raw flux)
- Red Hot Bloom (raw flux)
- Rhododendron
- Snaptail
- Soot Flower
- Strangler Bloom
- Thistle
- Toxic Soot Flower
- Volatile Fever Blossom (raw flux)
- Wild Carrot Flower
- Wild Gourd Blossom
- Wild Melon Blossom
- Wild Tato Blossom

**Ingredients**

- Dirty Water x2
- Nuclear Material x1
- Inert Flux x3

**Spoil Rate**

- Base: 6 Hours
- 30% Reduced Spoil Rate: 7.8 hours
- 50% Reduced Spoil Rate: 9 hours
- 60% Reduced Spoil Rate: 9.6 hours
- 90% Reduced Spoil Rate: 11.4 Hours

**Crafted at**

- Cooking Station > All Drinks
- Cooking Station > Plants
- Cooking Station > Prepared

**Perk Cards and Effects**

- Super Duper: Works when crafting.
- Stacking Effects: 
 - Stacks with Green Thumb.
 - Stacks with Backwoodsman 4.
- Persistence: This buff remains active even if you server-hop or leave the game.
- Stacks with other Tea's

**Obtained via**

- Pre-Made Gamma Green Tea: Drops as a reward for every successful completion of The Big Bloom event.
- Plan: 
 - Has a 7.69% chance to drop as an event reward from The Big Bloom.
 - The plan is tradeable and will continue to drop even after it has been learned.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_37a8ee666027440d97d4c2ae0b5393e1~mv2.png)
